chunks: And from him, from Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) commanded us to perform ghusl from Fakh before entering Mecca.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing ghusl at Fakh before entering Mecca?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the specific ritual preparation of entering Mecca, prescribing a *ghusl* at Fakh—a location historically situated between Mecca and Medina—before crossing the Miqat boundary. In Shia jurisprudence, this practice underscores the emphasis on physical and spiritual purification (*taharah*) as a prerequisite for honoring the sanctity of the Holy City, distinct from the general state of *Ihram* required for Hajj or Umrah.
